title: A11y Playtest Captioner
user: Browser-game creators who need to author and hear concise, multilingual descriptions for important visual game states before inviting disabled playtesters.
smallest_useful_product: An npm library plus local preview page: developers register named canvas/game states, write localized descriptions and focus order, then test them with keyboard navigation and browser speech synthesis.
success_measure: A pilot game adds descriptions for ten critical states in under one hour, and a keyboard-only reviewer can identify the active objective and available actions in 90% of scripted states.
constraints: Do not claim WCAG or game-accessibility compliance.
